t: Milwaukee M18BLPDRC cordless combi drill delivers powerful drilling and screwdriving performance across tough trade environments. Designed for electricians, plumbers and carpenters working in tight or overhead spaces. The compact body is 12% shorter than the previous generation (M18CBLPD-402C) of the same tool, measuring 148mm in length to allow easy access to confined areas. Features brushless motor technology which provides 62Nm of torque, and Redlink overload protection to protect battery and tool under high strain, extending total tool life. Equipped with an air-cooled motor which prevents overheating during continuous operation, and rubber overmould grip for improved comfort and control. Drilling capacities reach 16mm in masonry, 13mm in steel and 52mm in wood to tackle diverse tasks. Also includes all-metal gear case, durable 1/2" metal chuck and all-metal reversible belt clip for hanging the tool quickly and easily. Supplied with 2 x 18V 5.0Ah Li-Ion batteries, M12-18 charger and blow-moulded carry case.
